notes.title: Playtest Patch
notes.notes:
Since the start of the playtest event a few patches have been pushed.
This might be the last for this playtest, as development is concentrated on world building and larger features for a while.
Some of the changes so far:

- added sound for item drops
- added sound when picking item on ground
- added sound when interaction with quest item (honey / trial prop target, dummy...)
- added sound when equiping weapon / equipment
- added sound when "level up"
- added message when inventory is full
- game feel improvements - especially clicking outside walking area
- more item variety, especially early game
- shields now shown, and can block.
- shields can't be worn with 2-handed weapons.
- a few more skills
- UI improvements: potions, equip double/shift click
